name: Xperia Z

images.credit: Clivejb, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: GSM/GPRS/EDGE 850/900/1800/1900, HSPA+ 800/850/900/1700/1900/2100, LTE 800/850/900/1500/1800/2100/2600, (Network specifications varies across models)

Body.Other: Available in White, Black, and Purple, IP55 / IP57 (Dust protected, Water jet protected & Waterproof up to 1 meter in 30 minutes), 1seg (SO-02E variant only), Osaifu-Keitai (SO-02E variant only), NOTTV (SO-02E variant only), POBox Touch 5.4 (SO-02E variant only), Charging With Dock Charger

Platform.Operating system: Android:, Android Jelly Bean, 4.1.2 Jelly Bean (initial), 4.2.2 Jelly Bean, 4.3 Jelly Bean, Android KitKat, 4.4.2 KitKat, 4.4.4 KitKat, Android Lollipop, 5.0.2 Lollipop, 5.1.1 Lollipop (current), Unofficial Android 12L
Platform.CPU: 1.5 GHz quad-core Krait 300 (1.5 GHz Qualcomm APQ8064+MDM9215M Quad Core)

Memory.Card slot: up to 32 GB microSDHC (officially), up to 128 GB microSDXC (unofficially)

Display.Display: 5.0 in Full HD TFT multitouch capacitive touch screen with 441 ppi, 16 million colours, Bravia Engine 2 and scratch resistant glass protection

Cameras.Rear camera: 13.1 MP Exmor RS IMX 135, backside illuminated sensor with LED flash and HDR 1080p video recording @ 30 fps and 16x digital zoom
Cameras.Front camera: 2.2 MP Exmor R sensor (1080p video recording)

Sound.Sound: Walkman Music Player with Clear Audio+, Clear Stereo, Clear Phase, XLoud

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi, DLNA, Miracast, GPS/GLONASS, NFC, Bluetooth 4.0, MHL, HDMI (via MHL), IR Blaster (SO-02E variant only), Screen Mirroring, DualShock 3
